name: anydesign
summary: Claude skill that extracts a design system from images, websites and Figma files, or copies one element.
description: A Claude skill that analyzes a screenshot, website URL or Figma file and writes a 7-section design.md with tokens, components, layout and brand rules, plus a W3C DTCG design-tokens.json and an optional WCAG 2.1 contrast report. Element mode copies a single element (navbar, card, illustration) into a scoped spec with a paste-ready rebuild prompt or a token-grounded image prompt, and eight standalone Python CLI scripts work without Claude.
contains: design.md: 7-section design spec with tokens and brand rules
element mode: rebuild prompt or image prompt for one element
works with v0, Lovable, Cursor, Bolt and Claude Code
